change: A manual GitVerse master-only workflow now starts a bounded, read-only SSH sampler. Each sample runs the existing exact-volume/private-metric audit against the deployed revision, logs UTC time, available/required/reserved bytes, and fails if headroom is below the guarded threshold. A successful sampler run requires at least two active reservation samples (peak at least 25,000,000 bytes) followed by release to zero. It creates no attachment files, users, containers, or backups.
